finite_partial_rule.level: Annotated source-carrier strings, not pixels or a self-classifying glyph decoder
input_required: mark role τ or μ supported by source explanation
resolved carrier span and insertion gap
procedure: If any required field is unresolved, return UNRESOLVED without consulting a word list.
For one resolved τ or μ supplement, insert that single letter once at the registered gap in the retained sequence.
Keep written retained letters in order; do not silently expand ordinary abbreviation signs, erase duplicate letters, or infer accent marks.
finite_partial_rule.executable_expression: resolve(s, letter, gap) = UNRESOLVED if s/letter/gap is unresolved; otherwise s[:gap] + letter + s[gap:], with letter in {τ, μ} and 0 <= gap <= len(s).
withheld_cases: B_TOIS: mark-to-span / insertion-gap assignment unresolved natively
B_META_FRAGMENT: complete literal sequence and τ gap unresolved
B_DOUBLE_NOTE: lexical abbreviation expansion, not one-letter supply
finite_partial_rule.capacity_claim: Two resolved annotated supplement examples only; no complete paragraph reconstruction or autonomous source decoder.

source_constraints_and_countercases.constraint: Printed passage expands ordinary abbreviations and ligatures and approximates distorted shorthand. Printed carrier spelling is not a native stroke inventory.
source_constraints_and_countercases.consequence: Keep literal native, ordinary expansion, shorthand supplement and normalized editorial text as distinct layers.

source_constraints_and_countercases.constraint: τ dots can move below iota to avoid the ordinary iota dots above.
source_constraints_and_countercases.consequence: Above=τ and below=μ is not an unconditional pixel-level classifier. This exception is edition-reported and was not independently viewed natively here.

source_constraints_and_countercases.constraint: τ dots can attach to symbols or otherwise written words; μ pair below the following letter is also used with otherwise written words.
source_constraints_and_countercases.consequence: A carrier may be a literal-letter span or an abbreviation sign. The span is an input obligation; nearest-stroke anchoring is not established.

source_constraints_and_countercases.constraint: The εἰς compendium already includes sigma but gets an extra written sigma; κατά compendium already represents the whole word but gets alpha.
source_constraints_and_countercases.consequence: Literal concatenation would produce duplicate letters. A separately identified overlap operation is needed for these exact sign cases. No generic deletion or deduplication rule is licensed, and their native carriers were not admitted in this bounded 219v inspection.

source_constraints_and_countercases.constraint: Doubling a single note can mark plural.
source_constraints_and_countercases.consequence: Repeated notes can contribute number rather than duplicated phonetic letters; do not repair all repeats by overlap deletion. Inflected expansion needs additional source-local information.

source_constraints_and_countercases.constraint: Table is nonexclusive/inconsistent, contains entries absent from running text, two εκ forms and a two-word υπερ τας entry; some dots, meanings and shapes are uncertain.
source_constraints_and_countercases.consequence: Do not treat all dots as τ/μ, all entries as one letter, or the table as a total deterministic running-text dictionary.

source_constraints_and_countercases.pointer: Allen 288, I fourth word and IV penultimate word
source_constraints_and_countercases.constraint: Allen leaves a word in I contextually unresolved and questions superfluous dots in IV.
source_constraints_and_countercases.consequence: Retain unresolved marks/readings; do not rescue a total rule by forced context expansion.

decision: Retain an executable two-case annotation-level supplement rule and native/edition separation. To infer a productive source decoder, unresolved carrier spans, ordinary abbreviation expansions, overlap cases and inflection must be fixed from source evidence. No native 265v continuation or Voynich material was used to repair this rule; no Greek/Voynich correspondence is proposed.
